description: This Java source file defines a REST API endpoint for managing device credentials within the Eclipse Hono framework. It handles HTTP routes for retrieving and updating device credentials, communicates via Vert.x event bus, and implements CORS and payload handling.

classes.name: CredentialsManagementHttpEndpoint
classes.description: A REST API endpoint for managing device credentials, implementing GET and PUT routes, and handling credential retrieval and updates via Vert.x event bus.

methods.description: Returns the name of the endpoint, combining API version and endpoint identifier.
